newsitem.title: USA: Cadus Pharmaceutical names Vitullo to board.
newsitem.headline: Cadus Pharmaceutical names Vitullo to board.

text.p: Cadus Pharamaceutical Corp. said it named Nicole Vitullo to its board to replace Thomas Shenk, whom the company appointed to its scientific advisory board.
Vitullo is a senior vice president at Rothschild Asset Management, a Britian-based investment company. Prior to that she was director of corporate communications and investor relations at Cephalon.
Shenk has served as a director of the company since its inception. Cadus is a biotechnology company based in Tarrytown, New York, focused on discovering small molecule therapeutics.
